product_one_liner.value: Fluxco is a transformer procurement marketplace that helps businesses source and compare transformers from a global network of OEMs, from specification through delivery, service, and warranty.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes a marketplace connecting transformer buyers to 150+ OEMs and supporting the procurement lifecycle.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link, and the company presents project-start/contact options rather than public pricing.

named_customers.notes: No qualifying Fluxco customer logos, named case studies, or review listing naming customers were found; the homepage and resources content did not supply customer names.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports a company size of 11–50 employees; RocketReach search result indicates 13 employees. The narrower 11–20 band is supported by the reported 13-person count, while LinkedIn range alone spans multiple allowed bands.

hq_location.notes: Company contact address is in Austin, Texas; LinkedIn states Austin, Texas headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company profiles identify Fluxco as founded in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: Fluxco's Resources area contains industry/technical buyer guidance, but no qualifying engineering-authored posts describing product architecture, infrastructure, ML, data systems, incidents, or open-source work.

public_docs.notes: Homepage navigation/footer includes FAQ, resources, careers, and contact but no product documentation, help center, or developer portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles include a Full-Stack Software Engineer titled AI-Native Generalist, but none is titled AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision; AI-centric engineering work within a nonqualifying title does not meet the stated role-title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Fluxco's public privacy policy mentions AI service providers generically but does not identify a model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy page names no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification.

last_funding.notes: The reported latest round is a $26 million seed round announced in July 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: Fluxco's $26 million seed round was reported in July 2026, within the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current openings include multiple Enterprise Account Executive roles and an Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Founder Brian Tochman's LinkedIn post announces Fluxco's launch, dated approximately three months before the research date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete team roster or sufficiently verifiable dated leadership-change evidence was found to establish either that a C/VP joined or left, or that none did.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No accessible Fluxco job post, documentation, or integration page found in this research named a CRM or sales/marketing system.
